title: Regionals Porto and Sydney (Sat 7 Nov): results not published yet
detail: Limitless's tournament list had no entry for 7 Nov when checked (its newest listed event was dated 26 Jul, so the page may be lagging). We'll report winners and leaders once results appear. These were the first big events since the Mihawk ban.

title: OP-18 English release now shown as 20 Nov on Bandai's page; Japan date still disputed
detail: Bandai's English product page lists OP-18 The Dominance of God for 20 Nov 2026 (our calendar date). Japan is still unclear: retailers give 21, 22 or 28 Nov and no official Japanese page was found. We have not re-verified the official page ourselves today beyond the search listing.

title: Miyata Kard Market (Réunion): only the Delta Reign 6-booster bundle is in stock
detail: Today's page shows the Bundle of 6 (2nd wave) at €44.99 (was €49.99) as available. Elite Trainer Box €79.99, Display 36 €239.99, 3-pack €19.99 and single booster €7.99 are all marked sold out. The page's own stock counter disagrees (says 5 in stock), so check with the shop before going.

title: Delta Reign: still no solid English price data two days after release
detail: Trackers disagree: TCG Watchtower shows Mega Rayquaza ex 084 around $13.28 (4 Nov), another listing a TCGplayer market of $8.92. Treat all as unconfirmed until a few days of sales settle. Price checks on your cards were not run today (the collection file has no TCGdex ids).
